news.title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds on Solana, Ethereum
news.body: BlackRock launched a tokenized money market fund for stablecoin reserves that uses Solana alongside Ethereum.

news.title: Michael Saylor Tops Cash Reserves Again With $250 Million
news.body: Michael Saylor is still boosting his company's cash reserves after it stopped buying Bitcoin for about six weeks amid the prolonged crypto market downturn.
